subject: How do we install bug-fixed STAN (including rstan) version 2.14?

messages.author: 706a0969d0cf5307
messages.subject: How do we install bug-fixed STAN (including rstan) version 2.14?
parts:
I noticed this announcement about STAN bugs:

http://andrewgelman.com/2016/12/20/stan-2-10-stan-2-13-produce-biased-samples/

I noticed "Stan 2.14 is out now" mentioned here:

http://discourse.mc-stan.org/t/stan-2-10-through-2-13-have-broken-samplers/176/5

I'm guessing Stan 2.14 is the version that has bug fixes, and is on GitHub but is not yet on CRAN.

How do we install Stan 2.14 on GitHub? I tried the following procedures (i.e. Procedure 1, Procedure 2), but they didn't work and they seem too complicated. Could you please direct me to the simplest installation procedure that works?

Procedure 1:

I went here: https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan and clicked the green "Clone or download" button to get "https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan.git".

In my terminal, I typed:

"git clone https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan.git"

This created a folder "rstan". I cd'ed into this folder.

Then I followed the instructions in the example at https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/How-to-work-with-the-stan-submodule-in-rstan-repo%3F, namely:

git submodule update --init
git submodule update

Then I cd'ed into the rstan subfolder (i.e. rstan/rstan) and followed the instructions in INSTALL.txt by typing "make install". I got an error about RInside, so I installed the RInside package, and then typed "make install" again, which gave an error about the Rmd file:

R --vanilla CMD build rstan --md5    # --no-build-vignettes --no-manual
* checking for file ‘rstan/DESCRIPTION’ ... OK
* preparing ‘rstan’:
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... OK
* cleaning src
* installing the package to build vignettes
* creating vignettes ... ERROR
Quitting from lines 27-35 (external.Rmd) 
Error: processing vignette 'external.Rmd' failed with diagnostics:
engine.opts$x must be a character string; provide a name for the returned `stanmodel` object.
Execution halted
make: *** [rstan_2.14.1.tar.gz] Error 1

Procedure 2:

It looks like the R packages I need to install are:

(1) https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/tree/develop/StanHeaders

(2) https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/tree/develop/rstan/rstan

To install (1), in an R session, I typed: 

devtools::install_github("stan-dev/rstan/StanHeaders",ref="develop")

but got an error about StanHeaders not compiling:

Downloading GitHub repo stan-dev/rstan@develop
from URL https://api.github.com/repos/stan-dev/rstan/zipball/develop
Installing StanHeaders
'/usr/local/lib64/R-3.3.0/bin/R' --no-site-file --no-environ --no-save  \
  --no-restore --quiet CMD INSTALL  \
  '/tmp/RtmpYrux1g/devtools3a82732003c7/stan-dev-rstan-586a1d6/StanHeaders'  \
  --library='/home/students/qszhang/R/library' --install-tests 

* installing *source* package ‘StanHeaders’ ...
** libs
make: *** No rule to make target `cvodes/src/cvodes/cvodes.o', needed by `static'.  Stop.
ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘StanHeaders’
* removing ‘/home/students/qszhang/R/library/StanHeaders’
* restoring previous ‘/home/students/qszhang/R/library/StanHeaders’
Error: Command failed (1)
In addition: Warning message:
GitHub repo contains submodules, may not function as expected!
